---
name: Bug report
about: Report reproducible Zaxy behavior that looks incorrect
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
---

## Zaxy version

Version, install source, Python version, operating system, and projection
backend.

## Reproduction

Exact commands, API calls, MCP tool calls, Eventloom fixture, or minimal project
needed to reproduce the issue.

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead? Include error text, command output, or relevant logs.

## Memory and projection state

Include `zaxy memory status --graph` output when the issue touches Eventloom,
checkout, retrieval, or projection behavior.

## Verification tried

List tests, docs, release checks, or manual commands already run.
